erasedBasis.sentence: Will she claim the interference or let the assumption stand?
The presiding Dohkar turns at last, his authority intact yet the interruption he never made still echoing in the air.
The assembly watches me now, the assumption of interference still hanging between us.
Tell them the interference was mine, or let the assumption stand.
